method: Actual extracted production capture/recheck/print functions and hold/BEFORE180TURN IRQ cases. Only host IRQ delivery, UART duration, sensor readings and wheel feedback are synthetic. Includes transient/permanent trip, repeated triggers, stale samples, moving wheels, invalid lookup values, mismatched mean, emergency, sleep, task cancellation, UART rebound, coordinate/encoder continuity and local correction range. Not a physical dynamics or optical accuracy test.
